title: "Matters-arising register"

Use this to carry an unresolved matter from one meeting to the next without repeating the whole discussion. Link its actions, questions and decisions instead of maintaining separate conflicting copies.


<details class="template-copy">
<summary>Open the blank copyable template</summary>

Copy this plain-text version into your approved project record. Repeat entry fields as needed and remove prompts that do not apply. The guidance and examples below help you complete it.

```text
Matters-arising register

Blank register

ID: M-001
Origin/date: [ ]
Matter: [ ]
Current evidence: [ ]
Next step: close / continue / escalate / transfer
Owner: [ ]
Next review: [ ]
```

</details>

## Completed example

*Illustrative example; replace these details with your own verified record.*

| ID | Origin/date | Matter | Current evidence | Next step | Owner | Next review |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| M-004 | Meeting 3 | Data-access confirmation | partner has not signed | escalate to partner lead | supervisor | Friday |

## Check your record

At the next review, update the evidence and choose whether to close, continue, transfer or escalate the matter. Give any follow-up action an owner and date.

## Scenario test

If the same item appears at three meetings, agree what will happen next, who will do it and by when.
